jerseys.description: Arsenal home kit: red body, white raglan sleeves, maroon Adidas shoulder stripes, Emirates FLY BETTER sponsor, Arsenal crest, maroon collar trim
Manchester City home kit: sky blue gradient to light blue at hem, white crew neck, Puma logos, Etihad Airways sponsor, OKX sleeve logo, white side panels
AC Milan away kit: white with subtle grey wavy tonal pattern, gold Puma logo, Emirates FLY BETTER sponsor, ACM crest with gold laurel wreath, black-red collar trim
FC Barcelona x Kobe Bryant kit: black to purple vertical gradient body, yellow Spotify circle sponsor, holographic Barça crest, Kobe sheath logo, black snakeskin-pattern sleeves with AMBILI text
Chelsea home kit: black body, yellow Nike swoosh, yellow Chelsea lion crest, yellow flame-pattern V-neck collar and sleeve cuffs, yellow curved side piping
FC Barcelona special kit: navy base with maroon abstract floral pattern, yellow Barça script text, Barça crest, yellow-tipped navy cuffs, MÉS QUE UN CLUB collar detail
Real Madrid x Louis Vuitton kit: dark teal with LV monogram jacquard pattern, white Adidas stripes, Emirates sponsor, Real Madrid crest, ornate white sleeve cuff borders, number 4 circle patch
Manchester City away kit: white base, central vertical blue gradient stripe, Puma logos, Etihad Airways sponsor, OKX sleeve logo, blue diamond side inserts
FC Barcelona home kit: vertical navy, royal blue and burgundy stripes, yellow Nike swoosh, yellow Spotify circle sponsor, Barça crest, navy V-neck and side panels
FC Barcelona x Jordan kit: charcoal grey with ornate baroque mandala pattern, white Jumpman logo, stylized Barça crest in black/white/gold, red side panels and shoulder piping
Argentina home kit: vertical light blue and white stripes, gold Adidas logo, AFA crest with three gold stars, FIFA World Champions 2022 patch, white sleeves with three black stripes
Portugal home kit: red with tonal wavy horizontal line pattern, white Puma logo, Portugal crest, teal V-neck and cuff trim, red mesh side panels
Portugal away kit: mint green and white abstract brushstroke pattern, burgundy Puma logos, Portugal crest centered, dark teal side panels, white mesh inserts
Real Madrid home kit: white base, navy/teal V-neck collar and cuffs, hot pink Adidas shoulder stripes, Emirates FLY BETTER sponsor, Real Madrid crest, HP logo on left sleeve
Manchester United home kit: bright red, white Adidas shoulder stripes, polo collar with black-white trim, Snapdragon sponsor, Man United crest, DXC sleeve logo
Liverpool home kit: deep red/maroon with white diagonal line and stipple pattern, white Adidas stripes on shoulders, Standard Chartered sponsor, LFC crest, white collar and cuffs
Liverpool away kit: white with tonal jacquard oval pattern, maroon Adidas stripes on shoulders, maroon Standard Chartered sponsor and LFC crest, maroon V-neck and cuff trim, Expedia sleeve logo
